earlyFailure.reason: Experiment flags were read before FCommandLine initialization. Moved to ConfigureStartup; v49 excluded from FPS.

flagForwardingFailure.reason: Startup mode assertion detected all instead of control before measurement. v52 forwards the explicitly validated experiment argument to UE.

interruptedCapture.reason: Incomplete before the user-reported power interruption. Retained as raw history; all final performance windows were collected after restart.

environment.boundary: User apps retained. Formal tests serial without builds, packaging or profilers. No exclusive CPU/GPU ownership.

boundary: Fixed-spawn ABBA, not a traversal low-frame or long-term stability test. Same Wasm switches isolate each change; a separate v47 comparison measures the combined net effect. 1% Low is inverse mean slowest 1% intervals. Short per-thread stack samples include waits, overlap inclusively, and exclude browser GPU process/GPU execution. No per-thread percentage is an exact saved frame cost.
